title: "Ringmin: minimum central circle software and exact finite certificates"
abstract: >-
  Ringmin provides software, exact finite certificate artifacts, and independent
  verification for the minimum central circle problem with surrounding circles
  of radii 1,2,...,n. This finite DCG pre-submission companion snapshot includes
  the standalone exact-arithmetic verifier for global brackets
  L_n < R*(n) <= U_n of width 10^-11 for n=3,...,14, their preserved inputs and
  provenance, and the working manuscript for Discrete & Computational Geometry.
  The public finite paper remains arXiv:2607.28654v2. This snapshot does not
  extend the finite certificate scope beyond n=14 or imply journal acceptance.
